September 2025 dividend month = 10.00% per annum. Source: Q3-2025 10-Q (2025-09-30) declaration table ("STRC Month ended September 30, 2025 ... 10.00% $0.833333333") and the rate-progression chart in the 8-K dated 2025-12-01 (9.00% / 10.00% / 10.25% / 10.50% / 10.75%). October 2025 dividend month = 10.25% per annum. Announced via website rate card.

November 2025 dividend month = 10.50% per annum. Source: Q3-2025 10-Q ("increased regular dividends on STRC Stock, most recently on October 30, 2025, from 10.25% per annum to 10.50% per annum for the monthly period commencing on or after November 1, 2025").

December 2025 dividend month = 10.75% per annum. June 2026 dividend month = 11.50% per annum. Rate explicitly maintained at 11.50% effective for monthly periods commencing on or after 2026-06-01 per 8-K dated 2026-06-01 ("maintain the regular dividend rate per annum ... at 11.50%").
